text:
Date: <mention-date start="2026-10-01"/> · Notes: **Wop testwell**
Attendees: Maya Chen, Daniel Ortiz, Priya Raman, Sam Okafor, Wop testwell
## Updates
- **Maya:** First meeting with Lena Fischer from Harbor Seed Fund went well. She wants to see beta numbers before the partner meeting.
- **Daniel:** Matching service v0.2 works but only uses shared courses. v0.3 will add free time and study style.
- **Priya:** Three app icon options ready. Team vote next week.
- **Sam:** Android and iOS beta builds are out to 40 Westbrook students through Tomas.
## Decisions
- Beta launch target: **November 2**, Westbrook University only
- Store submission deadline: October 25
## Action items
- [x] Daniel: ship matching v0.3 to staging
- [x] Priya: share icon options in the team chat
- [ ] Wop: create the beta launch checklist page
- [ ] Maya: schedule the pitch meeting with Harbor Seed Fund
